title: letter of credit document examination: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 95 min of staff time per presentation, averaged

steps.task: Receive the courier presentation, stamp the date of receipt, count originals and log it
Scan and index the documents; pull the credit and its amendments from the trade system
Check each document against the credit terms under UCP 600 and ISBP 821
Cross-check data between documents and recompute the invoice arithmetic
Screen parties, vessels, ports and goods against sanctions and dual-use lists
Review trade-based money laundering red flags: pricing, routing and customer profile
Four-eyes review of the examination; decide to honour or refuse
Draft the refusal notice or waiver request, or the settlement instruction (averaged)

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 25 min of human time per presentation, averaged

steps.task: Register the presentation, OCR the scans, pull the MT700 and MT707s, compute the day-five deadline
Label every page by document type and flag documents the credit calls for but are missing
Extract each document's fields with page citations, one call per document
Check dates, amounts, tolerances and arithmetic; screen names, vessels, ports and goods
Judge conflicts and wording against the credit and ISBP 821; cite each proposed discrepancy
Weigh price, route, goods and parties against the customer profile; list red flags
Clear or escalate every screening hit and red flag. No agent clears a sanctions hit
Draft the single refusal notice or waiver request from the discrepancies the checker confirms
Decide honour or refuse, approve the notice and send it. Every presentation gets a person
